integrity: Analytical determinant and spectral decompositions establish unrestricted theorem; supplied finite full-Hamiltonian numerical profiles and exact rational moment checks corroborate but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Two positive real edge conductances on a finite star; infinite-time Laplacian mixing only, not arbitrary weighted trees or adjacency dynamics. Priority subject to external validation, including possible stronger unpublished or unlocated theorems.
title: Sharp rank transitions for Laplacian quantum walks on two-conductance stars
